h1: Create Product Launch Content Before Launch Day
lead: Build anticipation for your reveal from one product photo. Make a teaser, a reveal clip and listing images before the launch date, without booking a shoot.

faq.q: Can I make launch content before production is finished?
faq.a: Start from a clear photo of the current sample or prototype. The teaser, reveal and listing images all use that one photo, so assets exist while production finishes.

faq.q: Can I change the launch date after making the video?
faq.a: Yes. Add the date, price and code as editable text after download, so confirmed details can change without regenerating the scene.

faq.q: Will anyone see my unreleased product?
faq.a: No. Your uploads and results stay private in your own account until you download and share them, so the product stays under wraps.

faq.q: What video size should a product launch use?
faq.a: Use 9:16 for Stories, Reels and TikTok, 1:1 for feeds, and 16:9 for a wide page or YouTube placement. Each size is its own generation.

faq.q: How long can a launch video be?
faq.a: Clips run 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. A 6-second clip works for a quick reveal; use 15 or 30 seconds when the launch needs a fuller product story.

faq.q: Can I run the finished clips as launch ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads carry no AIVideosUGC watermark and are yours to use in paid launch posts, subject to each platform's ad review.
